name: Uruguay

flag.description: Nine horizontal stripes, five white alternating with four light blue, starting and ending with white, and a white square in the upper hoist holding a golden Sun of May with a face.
flag.symbolism: The nine stripes stand for the nine departments the country had in 1830, and the Sun of May symbolises independence and the May Revolution of 1810.

hook: Uruguay tucks Argentina's Sun of May into a white top-left corner over nine stripes, like a sunny Greece.
trivia: Uruguay hosted and won the first FIFA World Cup in 1930.
The nine stripes match Uruguay's nine original departments; the country now has 19.
